product_summary: HPCL is an integrated downstream oil & gas Maharatna CPSE (own site, hindustanpetroleum.com): 9.5 MMTPA Mumbai refinery + 15.3 MMTPA Visakh refinery + 428 TMT Mumbai lube refinery; 25,238 retail outlets, 6,391 LPG distributorships, 60 aviation fuel stations, 4 lube blending plants, 5,440 km pipelines. Real product lines per site: (1) motor spirit/gasoline, high-speed diesel/gasoil, ATF, fuel oil, naphtha, kerosene/SKO, bitumen, LPG (domestic & non-domestic), lube oils and base oils, sulphur, petcoke; (2) petrochemicals at HRRL Pachpadra (JV, 74:26 with Govt of Rajasthan) — polyethylene under HP Durapol brand (2x500 KTA swing PE units, UNIPOL technology), polypropylene (2x500 KTA, Novolen), plus benzene, toluene, butadiene, 2.4 MMTPA total petrochemical capacity; (3) natural gas/CNG, biofuels/ethanol-blended fuels, CBG (SATAT), EV charging. International Trade page explicitly lists exports: fuel oil, naphtha, high-sulphur gasoil, high-sulphur gasoline; imports: LPG, gasoil, gasoline, lube oil base stock, bulk bitumen.
comment: Declared HS 996761 is a SERVICES code (CPC 9967 = wholesale trade services / 996761 = wholesale trade services on a fee or contract basis of solid, liquid and gaseous fuels and related products). It is not a goods code at all, so it cannot describe HPCL's actual trade, which is manufacture + sale of own refined petroleum products and petrochemicals. Classification is wrong: the company is a refiner/manufacturer (Maharatna CPSE), not a wholesale-trade-services provider. Correct mapping (HS-6): gasoline/motor spirit 2710.12; diesel/gasoil, ATF, kerosene, naphtha, fuel oil, lube base oils 2710.19 (sub-splits by product); LPG 2711.12/2711.13; natural gas/CNG 2711.21; bitumen 2713.20; bitumen emulsions/blends 2715.00; sulphur 2503.00; petcoke 2713.11/2713.12; polyethylene 3901.10/3901.20/3901.40; polypropylene 3902.10/3902.30; benzene 2902.20; toluene 2902.30; butadiene 2901.24; lubricants (finished) 3403.19/3403.99; ethanol/biofuel blends 3826.00 / 2207.20. Note: the petrochemical/polymer lines belong to the HRRL JV complex (Pachpadra) — HPCL markets them under HP Durapol, so for HPCL's own customs lines the polymer codes should be treated as group-level, not necessarily HPCL's own export lines. Per project rule 3, HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, code corrected to the actual goods codes above, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. All product lines above are taken from HPCL's own website pages (Our Businesses, HP Petrochemicals, International Trade); no customs/B-L line was examined in this HS-only pass, therefore the specific export/import flows (fuel oil, naphtha, HS gasoil, HS gasoline out; LPG, gasoil, gasoline, LOBS, bulk bitumen in) are marked 'заявлено, не подтверждено' pending customs-record verification. Trader signs: none — HPCL is a producer; the 996761 services code is likely a data-entry artefact from a trading-house template.
